race.description: Become A Brc Member Mdn Plate
race.comment: MALAMAGIC (8) is an appealing debutant for the sharp Gollan stable, with three 1000m Doomben trials behind him and a pedigree headed by full sister Malaboom, a Listed winner at this trip. Bright start anticipated. PALMANOVA (10) resumes with the strongest exposed profile after tackling the LR Oxlade Stakes here in June. Didn't have everything go her way there in testing conditions but has been readied with a trial and gets a good chance to shed the tag. SYMMETRIQUE (4) also starts his career with genuine claims after being fitted with a few sharp trials, while first-time blinkers and the apprentice claim add to the set-up. Former-Victorian NO NO NO NO NO (3) has had two trials for the new stable and is drawn cosy. Is another worth considering. DRAGON LINK (2) has attracted firm market support to date without saluting but looks to have come back in great order, dominating his lead-up trial. Expecting him to be right there fresh.
